label: MikroTik Chateau LTE18 ax
description: LTE18 desktop router with Wi-Fi 6: four gigabit ports plus one 2.5G port, SIM slot, 802.11ax dual band.
notes: Vendor figures from the MikroTik product page: 'we kept four Gigabit Ethernet ports and added a 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet' port, plus an LTE modem and Wi-Fi 6. The 2.5G port is modelled at 2.5G rather than 1G because that is the whole point of the model - rounding it down would hide the only fast port on the device. PoE in: none. The product page's Powering section lists 'Number of DC inputs: 1 (DC jack)' and no PoE-in row, so all five RJ45 ports are mains-powered; the Wi-Fi category is why the engine used to infer 12.95 W on each.
